To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) CRSum is a novel sentence regression framework that leverages contextual sentence relations for extractive summarizations; 2) CRSum achieves state of the art summarization performance on six benchmark datasets; 3) The two level attention mechanism in CRSum is able of paying attention to important content in the surrounding context; and 4) CRSum can be easily extended to other sentence regression based extractive summarization models.
CRSum is a novel and effective model that can automatically learn useful contextual features by taking advantage of both sentence level and word level contextual relations.

CRSum can automatically identify discriminative features by jointly learning sentence and context representations, and it can effectively capture important content in a sentence and its surrounding context.

a new model that is able to automatically learn contextual relations among sentences to improve the performance for extractive summarisation.
the use of contextual sentence relations to enhance the performance of sentence summarization.
